div.p: Most of my recent work follows the same five steps, in this order: privacy first, evidence before generation, and checks before anyone reads the answer.

div.div: Mask personal data and screen for prompt injection before the model sees anything.
A stateful LangGraph agent decides whether to look something up or take an action.
Dense + BM25 search, reranked 25 → 5, or MCP tools for SQL, ERP and PDFs.
An open-weight model, self-hosted on vLLM or Ollama, so data stays in-house.
Answers must be grounded and cite sources; LLM-as-a-Judge and regression tests run offline.
